نرتأ (form VIII)
# نَرْتَأِ (nartaʔi) /nar.ta.ʔi/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِرْتَأَى (irtaʔā)
# نُرْتَأَ (nurtaʔa) /nur.ta.ʔa/: first-person plural non-past passive jussive of اِرْتَأَى (irtaʔā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
